title: Persevering Grace
definition: Persevering Grace is God's keeping work by which true believers continue in faith until the end.
summary: Persevering Grace is God's ongoing work that keeps believers trusting, repenting, and enduring to the end.
christFocus: Jesus Christ keeps His sheep, intercedes for them, and brings them safely into glory.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine emphasizes that perseverance is real, but grace sustains it. Believers are called to continue in faith, yet their endurance is not self-generated heroism. God preserves His people through warnings, promises, discipline, fellowship, and the Spirit's power.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because endurance can feel impossible during suffering, temptation, or spiritual dryness. Persevering grace says God is not merely watching to see who survives; He is actively keeping His children. It encourages serious effort without self-reliance.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Use the means God gives: Scripture, prayer, church fellowship, confession, and obedience. Do not treat warnings lightly, and do not treat weakness as final. Ask the Lord to keep you faithful one step at a time.
